test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 30 April 1983 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 13 August 1989?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• **No of days from 1 May 1983 to 13 August 1989**-

 
 
• Days in year 1983 after 30 April 1983 = (365 - 31 - 28 - 31 - 30) = 245
 
• Days in year 1984, 1988 = 366 + 366 (leap year) = 732
 
• Days in year 1985, 1986, 1987 = 365 + 365 + 365 = 1095 
 
• Days in year 1989 upto 13 August = (31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 13) = 225
 
• **Total no. of days** = 245 + 732 + 1095 + 225 = **2297**
 
 
 
• Since, it was Saturday on 30 April 1983, every 7th day from 30 April will be a Saturday.
 
• Thus, **no. of odd days** = 2297/7 =** 1**
 
• Now, 30 April 1983 (Saturday) + 1 odd day = 13 August 1989 (Sunday)
 
• 13 August 1989 will be **Sunday**.

Hence, "option 2" is the correct answer.
